note: Configuration for OneHeroAI clinic AI twin onboarding. Every entry is assumed, confirm with OHAI.

requirements.label: Doctor High-Resolution Headshot
requirements.blocking_reason: Video Twin avatar generation requires a clean, high-resolution front-facing portrait in clinical attire.
requirements.whatsapp_template: Hi Dr. {doctor_name}, to prepare your OneHeroAI video twin avatar, could you send over a high-resolution front-facing photo in clinic attire with neutral lighting?

requirements.label: Direct Booking Link or WhatsApp Channel
requirements.blocking_reason: Voice Twin receptionist cannot triage or route patient appointment inquiries without a verified destination.
requirements.whatsapp_template: Hi {contact_name}, what direct link or WhatsApp phone number should your AI voice receptionist share with patients wanting to book an appointment at {clinic_name}?

requirements.label: Designated Clinical Approval Contact
requirements.blocking_reason: Weekly patient-education video scripts cannot be released to production without an authorized clinical sign-off persona.
requirements.whatsapp_template: Hi Dr. {doctor_name}, who from your clinical team should review and approve the weekly patient-education video scripts before they are published?

requirements.label: Doctor Recording Readiness & Audio Setup
requirements.blocking_reason: Voice twin cloning requires a clean audio sample or confirmed dedicated microphone in a quiet room.
requirements.whatsapp_template: Hi Dr. {doctor_name}, do you currently have a dedicated USB/lapel microphone for recording your 2-minute voice twin calibration sample, or should we ship a kit?

requirements.label: Clinic Logo & Brand Color Guidelines
requirements.blocking_reason: Video reels and patient FAQ widgets need clinic vector/PNG logos and brand styling for video templates.
requirements.whatsapp_template: Hi {contact_name}, could you share a high-resolution vector or transparent PNG of {clinic_name}'s logo for your custom video intro overlays?
